name: docs-init
title_zh: 仓库缺 docs/ 骨架时，一次补齐 ADR、计划
tagline_zh: 新仓库总忘了建 docs/，等想起来时决策已散落各处。它按标准结构补齐四类文档并生成 README 索引。
tagline_en: New repos always skip docs/ until decisions are scattered. It scaffolds ADRs, plans, memories, learnings with.
desc_en: Bootstrap the standard agentic docs/ structure (adrs, plans, memories, learnings) with README index files in the current repository. Use when the docs/ structure is missing or incomplete.
why_zh: 不是简单建文件夹，而是按 agentic workflow 的约定生成带索引的骨架。
why_en: Not just mkdir — it scaffolds the agentic workflow's canonical structure with index files, so future notes have a fixed home.
limit_zh: 只创建 docs/ 骨架与 README 索引，不写任何内容模板；若仓库已有 docs/ 但结构不全，需手动合并。
limit_en: Only scaffolds docs/ skeleton + README indexes, no content templates. If docs/ exists but incomplete, merge manually—no auto-migration of old files.
title_en: Scaffold missing docs/: ADRs, plans, memories, learnings
